hero.title:
A Legacy of Leather Craftsmanship.
A Future Built on Innovation.
hero.intro: KINGS - A vertically integrated multi-product and multi-brand company engaged in manufacturing of sustainable leather goods meticulously crafted with traditional skill & modern technology.

story.heading: From a small workshop to a vertically integrated modern facility
paragraphs: For the last 50 years, KINGS has been the first generation family-owned leather company with an in-house Tannery having a capacity of processing 200 hides per day. Kings International has been dedicated to producing premium leather and leather goods for international markets. Our expertise of skilled workforce and commitment to quality enabled us to manufacture products that meet the expectations of leading global brands. We combine traditional craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technology to produce genuine leather that offers superior strength, texture, durability and finish.

Every stage of production is carefully monitored to ensure consistent quality and customer satisfaction. Whether you require finished leather or leather accessories or customized manufacturing solutions, Kings International is a reliable & dependable business partner for sustainable products.

vision.title: Business Vision
vision.body: To expand our business by aiming to be 'ahead' and 'relatively better' than the competition in all the areas and to strengthen our brand presence in the international market by using superior & cleaner technology and smart ideas, thereby producing 'premium quality products' made from eco-friendly leather using sustainable tanning process and REACH & ZDHC compliant safe chemicals, thereby reducing carbon footprint and water footprint.

mission.title: Business Mission
mission.body: We are committed to satisfy our customers by understanding their specific needs and considering their expectations to supply trendy, innovative, and safe leather products at competitive prices using best business practices and focusing on core values, such as, environment sustainability, waste minimisation, recycling of resources, water & energy conservation, bio-diversity for better, cleaner & greener planet, social compliance and ethical sourcing, eventually giving value for money to the end customer.

items.title: Kings International Ltd.
items.body: Founded in Kanpur - the heart of India's leather industry - with a focus on hand-crafted leather goods.

items.title: Saddlery & Export Foundations
items.body: Building deep expertise in saddlery and harness manufacturing, and establishing export market worldwide & Participating in International trade fairs.

items.title: Vertical Integration
items.body: Creating In-house tanning & finishing facilities, giving full control over leather quality from through to finished leather.

items.title: Certifications & Sustainability
items.body: Aligning different Management Systems such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, SA 8000, Gold Rating of Leather Working Group for Sustainable Leather manufacturing, using REACH compliant chemicals.

items.title: Brand Portfolio
items.body: Growing a multi-brand portfolio, including Ryder for Belts, Pets' Pal for Pet Accessories Target for Hunting Accessories, Kingston and Equitel for Saddlery & Harness products

items.title: Global Reach
items.body: Serving different brands of wholesalers, distributors, retailers, and OEM partners across international markets from our integrated facility.

craftsmanship.heading: Our skill & craftsmanship.
craftsmanship.intro: Experienced Tanners,  Master Saddlers, Skilled Cutters, hand & machine stitchers - many with decades of experience on the same factory floor.
